method: Real in-app browser UI, observed through CUA locators, accessibility trees, screenshots and read-only DOM geometry. No application state injection.

scenarios.name: Travel flow
scenarios.observed: Home -> preferences -> trip -> comparison -> experience selection -> course. Inputs survive screen navigation. Separate home and settings contexts work.

scenarios.name: Profile validation
scenarios.observed: Age121 followed by next shows1-120 error and focuses age field; corrected22 permits proceeding.

scenarios.name: Explicit save and reload
scenarios.observed: Created course '와이어프레임 적용 확인' with22/Seoul/student input. Save opens collection; reload and reopen retain2 experiences,154min total,49min walk,6000won. Original '동선과 쿠폰 디자인 시연' remains and also reopens.

scenarios.name: Save error recovery
scenarios.observed: Save before acknowledgment focuses checkbox with visible explanation. Empty title opens title disclosure and focuses title with1-80 character error. Correct title resets acknowledgment; acknowledge and explicit save succeed.

scenarios.name: Current profile versus snapshot
scenarios.observed: Saved current age27, reload shows27. Opening course created with22 leaves current benefit summary at27. Course storage and current profile use distinct existing stores.

scenarios.name: Condition sheet
scenarios.observed: Age121 leaves apply enabled; submitting focuses condition-age with aria-invalid=true. Correcting22/Seoul/student and apply-only updates current comparison; reload restores saved27. Original blank profile restored by clearing only QA-created27 profile through UI.

scenarios.name: Independent benefits
scenarios.observed: Benefits opens directly after reload with blank optional profile and no completed travel flow. Official conditions/publication date and candidate limitations remain separate from fictional course costs.

scenarios.name: Course editing and zero selection
scenarios.observed: Move experience down/up works. Removing both draft items focuses course-back-experiences and hides save. Return and re-add garden gives101min/46min/6000won; reopening saved course restores original2items/154min/49min/6000won.
